reason: I didn't even know it was here, but if it's in my own building and a latte is about what I pay at Qahwa BLK, I'd try it a few times on the way up instead of walking over. It would stay an occasional thing until I know it's quick.
objection: A 70-seat sit-down place sounds slow. In the morning I need my coffee in two minutes, and I don't know if they're set up for grab-and-go or if I'll be stuck waiting behind people ordering frappes.
would_change_my_mind: If they were reliably fast in the morning, or let me pre-order so it's ready when I walk in, I'd switch my daily coffee there.
